newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks gain ground amid nervous trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks gain ground amid nervous trade.

text.p: Estonian stocks regained some of the ground lost earlier in the week but the market was still nervous on Wednesday, dealers said.
"Stocks tried to go higher earlier in the day but they fell back at the close. The market is still a bit nervous after the fall during this week," said one trader.
The index gained 0.21 percent to close at 186.82 on turnover of 27.9 million kroons on the official list.
Savings Bank was the most traded with 7.3 million kroons changing hands as it firmed to 89.50 kroons up 1.80 kroons.
Hansapank was up 0.75 kroons to close at 177.00 kroons after a trade of 6.4 million kroons of shares.
Foreskpank turned over 4.4 million kroons to nudge up by 0.10 kroons to close at 148.15 kroons.
Tallinna Pharma saw trade of 4.3 million kroons to firm by 4.05 kroons to register a closing price of 113.30.
Tallinna Pank was only slightly lower at 63.50 kroons, a dip of 0.50 kroons, and also saw a trade of 4.0 million kroons.
The over-the-counter market was slighly more active with trade of 9.3 million kroons.
The EMV construction company shares were the most traded with 4.5 million kroons changing hands to gain 40.00 kroons to close at 1,200 kroons.
Rakvere meat plant turned over 2.8 million kroons of shares to finish the day higher by 0.50 kroons at 14.75 kroons.
